main_text.p: 32. DEI Natura describitur, Exod.34.v.6.7. Ex deo na- dicitur, 1.Ioann.5.1. qui per fidem coniunctus est Christo vero DEI Filio, in quo etiam gratis habentur pro filiis iusdem Regni coheredibus. DEI nomen, Exod. 3.14. admirabile est, Psalm.8.v.1.10. aeternum, Pf.135.13. bonum, 54. Iac.2.7. excelsum, Ios.7.9. Esa.12.4. horribile gentibus, Malach.1.14. sanctum, Psalm.33.21.& 99.3.& 106.47.& 111.9. 138 2. Esaiae 57. Ezech.36.21.& 39.7. Amos 2.7. Luc.1.49. terribile, Pf.99.3.& 111.9. turris fortissima, Prou.18.10. frustra non assumendum, Exod.20.7. Deut.5.11. metuendum, Psalm 86.10. DEI nomen in Ierusalem, 2. Reg.21.v.4.7.& 23.27. Paral.6.6.& 12.13.& 33.v.4.7. DEI nomen civitati Ierusalem tribuitur, Ezech.48.35. Vide DEVS ab initio. DEI nomi- nis gloria quanti facienda, Ios.7.9. per illud iurandum Deut.6.13.& 10.20. Vide IVRISIVRANDVM, DEI nomen verbo plurali additum, ad indicandum Sacrosanctae Trinitatis mysterium, Gene.1.26.& 20.13. 2.Sam.7.23. Iob.25.1. Interdum pro adiectiuo sumitur, & significat idem quod maximus, vehemens, vel ingens, vt Genes.30.8. Psalm.37.& 68.16.& 80.11. 1.Sam.14.15. Additur etiam nomen pluralis numeri: vt Ios.24.19. dicitur Sancti in plurali numero, pro singulari: Sanctissimus, in superlatiuo gradu. Item Psalm.58.12. dicitur Iudices in plurali forma, pro Iudex. ¶ DEI opera admiranda, Psalm.139.14. Marci 12. Apocal.15.3. bona, Gene.1.31. 1.Timoth.4.4. imperuestigabilia, Eccles.8.17.& 11.5. magnifica, Psalm.92.6.& 111. perfecta.

page.notes: Right margin carries cropped, faint fragments of notes from the facing page; they are illegible and not transcribed. The marginal "32." is a section number set in the text column and is treated as a paragraph opener. Several words at the right edge are cut off by the binding and are marked by the scan's ragged edge; the final line "perfecta" is partly obscured and may be incomplete.
